title: Alif Wears a Wave, and the Meeting Comes Off the Page
label: ch:ur-script-meeting
canDo: I can write alif madda, pe and vao, name a non-joining letter on sight, read aam, aasmaan, purana, aap, voh and hun, and write the opening meeting exchange from dictation.

payoff.summary: Three more letters, and the exchange the book opens with -- salam, aap ka naam kya hai, mera naam ... hai, aap kaise hain, main ... hun -- is readable and writable end to end for the first time.
